name: Salsify
description: Salsify PXM API for one organization: products and their property values, digital assets, property definitions, list membership, exports, import runs and channel runs. API key (bearer) and organization id.
instructions:
## Salsify
This connector works with the **Salsify PXM API** (`https://app.salsify.com/api`) of one Salsify organization: products, digital assets, property definitions, list membership, exports, import runs and channel runs.

**Setup (about 3 minutes)**
1. Sign in to Salsify (ideally as a dedicated integration user with only the rights it needs) and open your profile, **API access** (https://app.salsify.com/app/profile/edit/api). Copy the **API key** (generate one if empty) into `SALSIFY_API_TOKEN`. It acts with that user's permissions and stays valid until it is regenerated.
2. Copy the **organization id** from the address bar: the part after `/orgs/`, starting with `s-` (for example `s-1a2b3c4d-...`). Paste it into `SALSIFY_ORG_ID`.

API access depends on your Salsify licence; ask your Salsify contact if the profile shows no API key. The token is sent as a bearer token.

**Where to start**: `salsify_list_products` (with a filter, or without for all) and `salsify_get_product` for one product. Property ids are the keys you see on products; `salsify_get_property` explains one.

**Products**: `salsify_list_products`, `salsify_get_product`, `salsify_create_product`, `salsify_update_product`. Values are keyed by property id (for example `Brand`, `Product Name`); a multi-valued property takes a list; null clears a value. Unknown property ids are created as text properties, so check spelling. `salsify_upsert_products` (bulk) and `salsify_delete_product` are installed switched off.

**Digital assets**: `salsify_list_digital_assets`, `salsify_get_digital_asset`, `salsify_create_digital_asset` (from a public URL; processed in the background), `salsify_update_digital_asset`. Link an asset to a product by setting the product's asset property to the asset id.

**Properties and lists**: `salsify_get_property`, `salsify_add_list_members`, `salsify_remove_list_members`. There is no documented call to list every property: export with entity_type attribute.

**Exports and imports**: `salsify_start_export` then `salsify_get_export` until completed; the url is a temporary link to the file. `salsify_get_import_run` reads an import run; `salsify_start_import_run` (runs a configured import, possibly over many products) is switched off.

**Channels**: `salsify_get_latest_channel_run` and `salsify_get_channel_run` show the state and feed link of a channel; `salsify_start_channel_run` is switched off because a run can publish to a retailer. The channel routes are used by Salsify's own integrations but are only partly described in the public reference.

**Filters**: Salsify filter language: `='Brand':'Acme'` (equals), `='Product Name':^'Mug'` (starts with), `='Price':>'10'`, `=list:12345` (list members); join conditions with a comma for AND. Property names and values sit in single quotes.

**Paging and limits**: page from 1 and per_page up to 100; meta.total_entries gives the total. Paging stops at the 10,000th result (422): use an export for larger sets. The organization may make 10,000 requests per hour across all its users (429 above; headers x-ratelimit-remaining and x-ratelimit-reset). Errors come as 422 with an errors list; 401 means the API key is wrong; 400 with a list of organizations means the organization id is missing or wrong.

SALSIFY_ORG_ID.label: Organization id
SALSIFY_ORG_ID.help: The part of the Salsify address after /orgs/, starting with s-, for example s-1a2b3c4d-5e6f-7a8b-9c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d.
SALSIFY_ORG_ID.patternMessage: The organization id starts with s- (copy it from the address after /orgs/).

SALSIFY_API_TOKEN.label: API key
SALSIFY_API_TOKEN.help: Profile, API access in Salsify: the API key of your user (or of an integration user).
SALSIFY_API_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste the API key without spaces.

401.hint: Salsify refused the API key. Copy it again from Profile, API access, or regenerate it there.

400.hint: Salsify could not pick the organization. Copy the organization id (starting with s-) from the address after /orgs/.

verifyHints.403: The user behind the API key lacks the permission for this call in this organization.
verifyHints.404: No product, asset or property with that id, or the organization id is wrong.
verifyHints.rate_limited: The organization used its 10,000 requests for this hour. Wait for the reset (x-ratelimit-reset seconds).

prerequisites: A Salsify organization whose licence includes API access, and a user (preferably a dedicated integration user) with an API key. About 3 minutes.

tools.name: salsify_list_products
tools.description: List products, optionally narrowed by a Salsify filter: every property value of each product as property id and value pairs, plus system fields such as salsify:id, salsify:created_at, salsify:updated_at, salsify:parent_id and the linked digital assets. meta holds total_entries, current_page and per_page. Up to 100 per page.

filter.description: Salsify filter language, for example `='Brand':'Acme'`, `=list:12345` (members of a list) or `='Product Name':^'Mug'` (starts with). Combine conditions with a comma (AND). Leave it out for all.

page.description: Page number from 1. Results stop after the 10,000th row; use an export for more.

tools.name: salsify_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by its product id: all property values (property id and value pairs, lists for multi-valued properties), system fields (salsify:id, salsify:parent_id, salsify:created_at, salsify:updated_at, salsify:version) and its digital assets with URLs.

product_id.description: Product id: the value of the property that holds the product id in your organization (often a SKU), exactly as stored.

tools.name: salsify_create_product
tools.description: Create a product from property id and value pairs; the product id property is required. A property id that does not exist yet is created as a text property, so check names first. Answers with the new product; 422 when the id already exists.

product.description: Property values, for example `{"SKU":"MUG-001","Product Name":"Adventure mug","Brand":"Acme"}`. Use the property ids of your organization; multiple values as a list.

tools.name: salsify_update_product
tools.description: Update property values of one product: only the properties sent change; each sent value replaces the stored one, null removes it. Enumerated values must already exist. Also salsify:parent_id. Answers 204.

product_id.description: Product id: the value of the property that holds the product id in your organization (often a SKU), exactly as stored.

values.description: Property values to set, for example `{"Brand":"Acme","Keywords":null}`.

tools.name: salsify_upsert_products
tools.description: Create or update up to 100 products in one call from a list of property value objects (each with the product id property). Answers with the stored products. A bulk write: installed switched off.

products.description: Up to 100 product objects, each with the product id property and the values to set.

tools.name: salsify_delete_product
tools.description: Delete one product permanently, with its property values. Cannot be undone. Installed switched off.

product_id.description: Product id: the value of the property that holds the product id in your organization (often a SKU), exactly as stored.

tools.name: salsify_list_digital_assets
tools.description: List digital assets (images, videos, documents), optionally narrowed by a filter: salsify:id, salsify:name, salsify:url, salsify:format, salsify:bytes, salsify:status, salsify:source_url, dimensions and custom metadata. Up to 100 per page.

filter.description: Salsify filter language, for example `='Brand':'Acme'`, `=list:12345` (members of a list) or `='Product Name':^'Mug'` (starts with). Combine conditions with a comma (AND). Leave it out for all.

page.description: Page number from 1. Results stop after the 10,000th row; use an export for more.

tools.name: salsify_get_digital_asset
tools.description: Get one digital asset: salsify:id, salsify:name, salsify:url (download link), salsify:format, salsify:bytes, salsify:status (in_progress, completed, failed), source URL, dimensions and custom metadata.

tools.name: salsify_create_digital_asset
tools.description: Add a digital asset from a public URL; Salsify downloads it in the background (salsify:status in_progress, then completed). Optional id, name and custom metadata. Link it to products by setting an asset property on the product.

source_url.description: Public URL of the file (no login).

asset_id.description: Id to give the asset (salsify:id); Salsify generates one when left out.

tools.name: salsify_update_digital_asset
tools.description: Update a digital asset: custom metadata, salsify:name, or salsify:source_url to replace the file (which creates a new link). Only the properties sent change. Answers 204.

values.description: Values to set, for example `{"salsify:name":"Front view","Asset Use":"Web"}`.

tools.name: salsify_get_property
tools.description: Get one property (attribute) definition: salsify:id, salsify:name, salsify:data_type (string, rich_text, number, date, boolean, enumerated, digital_asset, link, html), salsify:entity_types, salsify:attribute_group, salsify:role and whether it is multi-valued.

property_id.description: Property id, exactly as used as a key on products, for example Brand or Product Name.

tools.name: salsify_add_list_members
tools.description: Add products (or other entities) to an existing Salsify list by their ids. The list id is the number in the list URL in Salsify.

tools.name: salsify_remove_list_members
tools.description: Remove products (or other entities) from a Salsify list. The products themselves stay.

member_ids.description: Product ids to remove from the list.

tools.name: salsify_start_export
tools.description: Start an export file of products, digital assets, properties (attribute), enumerated values (attribute_value) or everything (all). Returns the export run id and status; poll salsify_get_export until status is completed and use its url to download.

format.description: File format: csv, xlsx or json (products), json or jsonl (all), csv or xlsx (others).

filter.description: Salsify filter language, for example `='Brand':'Acme'`, `=list:12345` (members of a list) or `='Product Name':^'Mug'` (starts with). Combine conditions with a comma (AND). Leave it out for all.

properties.description: With include_all_columns false: the property ids to export, single-quoted and comma-separated, for example `'SKU','Product Name','Brand'`.

include_all_columns.description: true (default) exports every property; false only those in properties.

product_type.description: Products only: leaves (default, lowest level) or all levels of a hierarchy.

compress.description: true compresses the file as gzip (products and all only).

sort_property.description: Products only: property to sort by.

sort_order.description: Products only: asc or desc, with sort_property.

tools.name: salsify_get_export
tools.description: Get the state of an export run: status (running, completed, failed), progress, estimated_time_remaining, failure_reason and, once completed, url (a temporary download link to the file).

tools.name: salsify_start_import_run
tools.description: Run an import that is already configured in Salsify (for example a JSON or CSV import from a mount point). It can change many products at once; installed switched off. 422 when the import queue (50) is full.

import_id.description: Import id (from the import URL in Salsify).

tools.name: salsify_get_import_run
tools.description: Get the state of an import run: status (running, completed, failed, canceled, stopped), progress and errors. Poll no more than every 15 seconds.

tools.name: salsify_get_latest_channel_run
tools.description: Get the latest run of a channel (a product feed or publication to a retailer or site): id, status (running, completed, failed), timestamps and product_export_url, a temporary link to the generated feed file.

channel_id.description: Channel id (the number in the channel URL in Salsify).

tools.name: salsify_get_channel_run
tools.description: Get one run of a channel: status, timestamps and product_export_url once completed.

tools.name: salsify_start_channel_run
tools.description: Start a new run of a channel, which regenerates its feed and, for publishing channels, sends it to the retailer or site. Installed switched off.
